newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ nine month operating profit rises 14.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: BNZ nine month operating profit rises 14.8 pct.

text.p: The National Australia Bank owned Bank of New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday its nine month operating profit rose 14.8 percent to NZ$264 million from $230 million.
Profit in the June quarter was $70 million. No comparision was provided.
Managing director Gordon Wheaton said the result featured continued growth in the sales of insurance, unit trust and superannuation products.
"We've also achieved significant growth in housing lending," he said.
Housing loans were up 15 percent over the same period last year with the main growth in fixed rate lending.
He said volatile market conditions were putting real pressure on the bank to review interest rates.
"And we expect to see a continuation of the tough business environment," he added.
